name: Lyo.Rfid
tagline: ISO 15693 block read/write, frames, and a transceiver port.
description: Read and write ISO 15693 blocks through `IRfidTag`. `MemoryRfidTag` keeps the blocks in a buffer for tests and dumps. `Iso15693Tag.OpenAsync` inventories one tag on `IIso15693Transceiver` and takes the block size from GET SYSTEM INFORMATION. `Iso15693Crc` is the ISO 15693 CRC-16 (poly 0x8408, init 0xFFFF, least-significant byte first). A PN5180-class reader implements the transceiver. Type 2 NFC readers do not speak this protocol.
features: **Blocks.** `ReadBlocksAsync` and `WriteBlockAsync` move whole blocks. A write that is not `BlockSize` bytes throws.
**Memory size.** `OpenAsync` reads the 2-byte GET SYSTEM INFORMATION field. Block count is the first byte plus one (at most 256). Block size is the low 5 bits of the second byte plus one.
**Transceiver.** One call carries the whole frame, CRC included. The caller builds the command; the reader only moves bytes.
**CRC.** `Iso15693Crc.Append` adds the two CRC bytes. `Verify` throws `RfidException` when they do not match.

examples.title: Write and read a block on an in-memory tag
